questions.question: Your background includes sales-and-use tax reporting at Macquarie Group and Beauty. What direct experience do you have preparing or reviewing individual and business income-tax returns, and how would you identify issues before a return is finalized?
Walk me through how you performed month-end and year-end closes for fixed assets and tax accounts at Macquarie Group, including the adjustments, reconciliations, and documentation you prepared.

You have used JDE, CAMS, SAP, AS400, and Microsoft Office, but QuickBooks is not listed. What accounting systems have you learned most recently, and how would you become productive in QuickBooks in a paperless, multi-screen environment?
Describe a time when an audit, reconciliation, or review of invoices/work orders revealed an incorrect coding or tax issue. How did you investigate it, correct it, and prevent recurrence?

At The Southern Company, you were a go-to person for finance-tag questions and led monthly policy meetings with administrative managers. How did you tailor technical guidance to non-finance stakeholders and confirm they understood the required action?

This role requires leadership of tax and accounting projects and staff. Drawing on your experience training associates on tax procedures and new accounting assistants, how would you assign work, review quality, and coach a team through a deadline-heavy tax period?

Suppose you are reviewing a business client’s year-end file and find that sales-tax accruals do not reconcile to the general ledger while payroll-tax and 1099 deadlines are approaching. How would you prioritize the work, investigate the discrepancy, and communicate status to the client and manager?
What controls and procedural checklist steps would you establish for recurring closings and year-end adjustments to ensure accuracy, timely review, and a clear audit trail?

What interests you in moving from accounting roles in government, energy, finance, and retail operations into an in-office Accounting Manager / Senior Tax Accountant position serving tax and accounting clients, and what do you want to learn or develop in the role?

The position prefers CPA-firm experience and a CPA license or progress toward one, neither of which is shown in your profile. What exposure, if any, have you had to CPA-firm-style client service or return review, and what are your plans regarding CPA eligibility or other tax-focused professional development?
